Publer.note: Own About page says it started as a side project in 2012 (self-reported). Directories say 2015/2017. Product Hunt shows a Nov 2022 relaunch, so public launch year unclear.

Buffer.note: Built from Oct 2010, first version (bfffr.com) live Nov 30, 2010. Entrepreneur.com says 2011 (outlier).

Metricool.note: Started 2014 as Bloggerespacio, became Metricool in 2015. Directories mostly say 2015.

Pallyy.note: Started Dec 2019 as ShareMyInsights (Instagram analytics); scheduling went live Jan 2021 after Instagram opened its publishing API; renamed Pallyy 2021 (Product Hunt Jun 2021).

OneUp.note: Product Hunt and Capterra say 2017; PitchBook says 2016. No official About page found; earliest PH launch listed Sep 2018.

ContentStudio.note: Only directories (SourceForge, Gartner, CB Insights) say 2017; others say 2016. Company About page returned 404. Low confidence.

SocialBee.note: Own timeline lists launch June 2016. TechLeap says 2017 (outlier).

Blotato.note: No reliable date found. Product Hunt page shows 'Launched in 2026' (relative, likely a later launch); one low-quality profile says 2023. Founder Sabrina Ramonov.

Sendible.note: Current About page says started in London in 2009; founder Gavin Hammar has said he released it free to the public in mid-2008. Sources conflict.

Post Bridge.note: Founder Jack Friks says he built it in September 2024; Tiny Startups lists Oct 2024 launch.

Loomly.note: BusinessWire/TalkCMO say 2016; Seedtable and G2 say 2015. Began as Calendy and was renamed Loomly in 2017 per founder's Medium post (page itself not fetched, 403). Public launch year not confirmed.

Agorapulse.note: Pivoted from Facebook contest apps (and earlier company affinitiz, 2000) to social management in 2011; CEO said started late 2011-early 2012. Some profiles say 2010 or 2012. Company About page 404.

Sprout Social.note: Founded April 2010 (Wikipedia). About page says 'launched in 2010' in the origin story but its timeline lists the platform introduced 2011; S2 released Nov 2011. Launch year conflicts.

Vista Social.note: Product Hunt launch Nov 4, 2021. Founding year conflicts across directories (2019/2020/2022); founder Vitaly Veksler earlier built Social Report. No official company history found.

Hootsuite.note: Launched as BrightKit Nov 28, 2008 by Invoke Media (company press release also says Nov 28, 2008).

Later.note: Launched spring 2014 as Latergramme, rebranded Later in 2016. Some sources say founded 2013. Mavrck acquisition 2022. Secondary sources only.

Planoly.note: Own About page: launched in 2016 as first visual Instagram planner. Levels.fyi/Built In list 2015.

Outstand (outstand.so).note: No founder or founding date found; outstand.so has no About/changelog. 'Launched Oct 2025' appears only in competitor (Ayrshare) comparison content, so treat as low confidence.

Repurpose.io.note: Founder Hani Mourra; one review site says created Nov 2016. No official About page date found. Low-medium confidence.

Zoho Social.note: Product of Zoho Corp (no separate founding). Zoho's 'a decade together' community post and a 2021 '6 years' post put launch at 2015.

Typefully.note: First Product Hunt launch Dec 9, 2020 (Francesco Di Lorenzo, Fabrizio Rinaldi). Typefully Pro June 2021.

Tailwind.note: Co-founder Danny Maloney's account and Tailwind's site: Pinterest partner since 2012 (grew from BridesView). One article says the Tailwind app 'began' in 2015. First scheduler launch year not confirmed.

Meta Business Suite.note: Facebook Business Suite launched Sept 17, 2020 (Facebook+Instagram post scheduling). Predecessor Creator Studio appeared Aug 2018; Instagram scheduling added to it Aug-Sep 2019. Renamed Meta Business Suite later.

YouTube Studio scheduling.note: Scheduled publishing already existed by June 26, 2012 (official YouTube post about overhauling it); original introduction year not found. Studio mobile app added scheduling in 2017 (Tubefilter).

TikTok web video scheduler.note: TikTok for Business announced Video Scheduler (web upload, up to 10 days ahead) in March 2021.
